phase: prospective diagnostic before candidate normalized values are calculated
purpose: Assess complete public metadata and test documented processing without claiming full author QC replication
primary_reference: Published Data S2 donor 2 cluster centroids
primary_procedure: Import all 259 DCCs using unchanged Python parser and compare with GeomxTools
Treat Data S1 row order to GEO donor AOI numbering as a provisional mapping, not an explicit sample-ID join
For donor 2 use its 165 AOIs without ROI consolidation as specified by the paper
Use GeoMx DA count shift, aggregate endogenous targets, remove NegProbe-WTX, and record software behavior
Normalize gene counts to counts per million, log2, then quantile normalize across donor 2 samples
Calculate arithmetic cluster means using Data S1 labels and compare all 18676 genes by 9 clusters to Data S2
limits: The paper's default-QC description does not identify exact software settings; this is not independent full QC replication
No kidney QC thresholds or Q3 normalization will be substituted for the paper's CPM and quantile workflow
A failed comparison will be retained; no tuning to force agreement
The metadata mapping remains provisional unless independently supported; matching totals alone is insufficient
Healthy donor data cannot establish disease associations
